description: This file contains functions for managing TypeScript configuration defaults, including generating suggested compiler options, reading and writing tsconfig.json, and handling first-time setup. It is part of Next.js's internal build tooling.

methods.name: getDesiredCompilerOptions
methods.description: Generates a set of suggested and required TypeScript compiler options with reasons for each setting.

methods.name: getRequiredConfiguration
methods.description: Returns a partial set of TypeScript compiler options that are required based on desired defaults.

methods.name: writeConfigurationDefaults
methods.description: Asynchronously writes default or suggested TypeScript configuration options to a tsconfig.json file, handling first-time setup and reconfiguration.
